_note: Arrow wounds on slaughterfish: shafts through scales and fins, blood clouding the water. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the point punching through the scales. Scales tear loose and {name} darts back, snapping.
, the arrowhead tearing in where the scales are already torn. Blood clouds out around the shaft and {name} thrashes.
, and the arrow drives deep into the wound. Blood billows in a red cloud and {name} spasms violently.
, and it is too much. {name} rolls onto one side, the shaft standing from the body, fins twitching, blood spreading.
